baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb at word 1 makes Thamud the collective agent of declaring false, while the bi-phrase attached to word 3 ties that act to the collective's own excess.
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective does more than hold an incorrect belief: it issues a verdict that marks a claim or claimant false. The prefixed bi-phrase can carry cause or instrument, so boundary-crossing is both a motive for the verdict and a medium through which it is enforced.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or its bearer false supplies the core collective verdict.
Overstepping a proper bound in rebellion supplies the cause and manner of that verdict.

changed_reading.before: Thamud simply disbelieved because it was rebellious.
changed_reading.after: Thamud collectively pronounced truth false, with its own limit-breaking condition functioning as both pressure behind and vehicle of the pronouncement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same word-1 act can concern whether a charge proves true in performance, and word 3 names the force that pushes performance beyond its proper limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth and falsehood can be tested by whether an undertaking is carried through. Joined to transgressive overflow, denial can therefore name a failed charge or betrayed obligation, not speech alone.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves false by not being carried through supplies a performance test for denial.
Rebellious boundary-breaking supplies the failure condition for the entrusted charge.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a proposition stated or believed.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also conduct that makes an entrusted charge come out false by refusing to carry it through within its bounds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The bi-phrase directly couples the word-1 falsifying act to the word-3 noun whose inventory includes a force rising beyond measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verdict of falsehood is driven by a flood-like social force. Once the collective rises beyond a boundary, denial becomes an overwhelming pressure that can make falsehood operative even without changing what is true.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the judgment imposed by the collective.
Water or force surging beyond measure supplies a physical model for how the judgment becomes socially overwhelming.

changed_reading.before: The stated cause is generic moral arrogance.
changed_reading.after: The cause is a surging collective force that overruns a boundary and gives a false verdict practical dominance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Emergence into visibility and active unveiling alternate with covering. Against that cycle, the focus denial reads as a cover repeatedly laid over what repeatedly becomes visible, not as a one-time absence of evidence.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false supplies the epistemic intervention made by Thamud.
Coming out into sunlight supplies an initial movement from concealment to exposure.
Uncovering and manifestation sharpen exposure into active disclosure.
A covering laid over and hiding something supplies the counter-movement performed by denial.

structural_cues: The opening sequence alternates following, disclosure, and covering before the focus gives Thamud an active falsifying verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, unveiling, and covering; I infer an epistemic cycle in which denial re-covers disclosed evidence. A live alternative is that the cosmic alternation frames the focus by contrast without describing denial's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Thamud rejected a message it did not accept.
changed_reading.after: Thamud's denial actively re-covered a truth that the surrounding sequence imagines as repeatedly brought into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: A right or liability can follow its bearer, while an aftermath remains as a thing's tail or trace. The collective verdict does not erase the denied claim; it converts the claim into something that follows the deniers and becomes consequence.

activation_trace.role: The attempt to mark a claim false supplies the act that tries to cancel its standing.
A right or liability following its owner supplies the persistence of what denial cannot discharge.
A remainder or trace supplies the eventual form taken by the still-following claim.

structural_cues: The focus stands between an early act of following and the closing mention of an aftermath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following liability and residual trace; I connect them across the sequence as a temporal arc of an uncancelled claim. The live alternative is that the first is only lunar following and the last only the aftermath of punishment.

changed_reading.before: Declaring the warning false disposes of it for the deniers.
changed_reading.after: The denied claim remains attached as a trailing liability and eventually returns as the event's residue and consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building by joined parts, spreading a stable field, and proportioning a self establish an architecture of fitted relations. Transgression is then not vague wickedness but load, reach, or force passing the limits that let the architecture hold; denial is its cognitive and social breach.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a proper bound supplies the breach of an ordered construction.
Failure to carry a charge through supplies the behavioral failure produced by that breach.
Construction by joining parts supplies the load-bearing order that excess violates.
Spreading and extending supplies the bounded field in which communal action occurs.
Integrity and completion within a thing supply the fitted self that transgression deforms.

structural_cues: Verses 5-7 repeat a made object followed by a perfect shaping verb and the same feminine pronoun before the focus reuses that pronoun for Thamud's excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, extension, completion, and limit-crossing; I infer that these form a normative architecture with failure thresholds. A live alternative is that the created order serves only as contrast, not as a causal model for Thamud.

changed_reading.before: Transgression is an unspecified degree of rebellion.
changed_reading.after: Transgression is a structural breach of fitted limits, and denial is one way the communal architecture ceases to carry its charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired possibilities inside the self become two material operations: a wide rupture that breaches a cover and a protection that wards damage. The focus transgression selects and amplifies the rupture; the outward verdict of falsehood is the social expression of an inwardly available but refused guard.

activation_trace.role: Boundary-crossing supplies the focus-side realization of the inner breach.
Declaring false supplies the outward judgment generated by the selected inner path.
Taking something in wholly supplies a material analogy for alternatives becoming inwardly available, not a replacement gloss for the contextual verb.
A wide split and bursting-out supply the mechanics of a breached inner boundary.
Deviation from right and tearing a cover connect the physical rupture to moral action.
Warding off damage supplies the live protective alternative that the rupture defeats.

structural_cues: Verse 8 places the two opposed objects after one inward-directed verb and marks both with the same feminine pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies whole intake, rupture, and protection; I infer an arrow from inwardly held alternatives to the outward collective denial. A live alternative is that the focus describes communal excess without making a psychological claim about internal choice.

changed_reading.before: Thamud's excess is an externally observable social condition.
changed_reading.after: Its excess is also the enacted rupture of a protection already available within the self, with denial externalizing that refused guard.

context_deltas.mechanism: One treatment of ground opens it for growth; the opposed treatment hides something inside it and ends in failed pursuit. This converts denial from lack of recognition into anti-cultivation: recognized truth is pressed below the surface so that transgressive desire can occupy the visible field.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the public surface placed over what is suppressed.
A cultivator splitting the earth supplies productive opening of the inner ground.
Growth and increase supply the result of opening that ground well.
Missing the sought end supplies the eventual failure of concealment.
Secret insertion or burial supplies the active suppression beneath denial's surface.

structural_cues: Verses 9 and 10 form a parallel antithesis: success with cultivating the same pronominal object versus failure with burying it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ploughing, growth, concealment, and failed attainment; I treat the self as their shared material field and infer that denial is the public face of burial. A live alternative is the direct ethical contrast of purification and corruption without an epistemic suppression claim.

changed_reading.before: Denial is failure to recognize truth.
changed_reading.after: Denial is active burial of recognized truth, the inverse of opening the self's ground for growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dormant force is stirred into motion through the community's most wretched member. The individual does not replace collective agency; he concentrates and releases a regime already named as Thamud's own transgressive falsification.

activation_trace.role: The collective verdict of falsehood keeps responsibility at the communal level.
A head of misguidance supplies the social form in which collective excess can become concentrated.
Stirring something stationary from rest supplies the release of latent communal force.
Wretchedness opposed to flourishing marks the selected agent as the community's concentrated negative pole.

structural_cues: Verse 11 names Thamud as the agent, verse 12 narrows to one superlative member, and verse 14 returns to plural verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective subject, an aroused extreme member, and later plural action; I infer representative catalysis rather than solitary guilt. A live alternative is that the individual is simply the immediate actor while the collective's role is assent.

changed_reading.before: The community's denial and the worst member's action are separate levels of the story.
changed_reading.after: The worst member is the ignition point through which the community's already shared transgression becomes collective action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is carried by a messenger but also embodied in an animal and a defined share or channel of water. The immediate sequence from repeated denial to disabling the animal makes falsification performative: the community nullifies a sign by attacking the living arrangement that lets it signify.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving false through failed performance opens the focus to later enacted denial.
A thing's own indication counting as speech lets the protected arrangement carry an argument materially.
Messenger and message supply the explicit warning whose truth is at stake.
The concrete camel image supplies the living bearer of the sign and obligation.
A share of watering and its channel supply the bounded common resource the warning protects.
The repeated failed-charge image turns the warning into a test immediately answered by conduct.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies the concrete disabling act by which the community makes its verdict operative.

structural_cues: Verse 13 juxtaposes the messenger's warning, the camel, and its watering share; verse 14 links denial and hamstringing with successive fa-particles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message, embodied animal, water-share, repeated denial, and disabling action; I infer that the arrangement itself functions as an embodied sign and social test. A live alternative is that denial remains a prior belief and the hamstringing is only its separate consequence.

changed_reading.before: Thamud verbally rejects a messenger's proposition.
changed_reading.after: Thamud enacts denial by sabotaging an embodied sign and the bounded distribution of life-giving water that the sign protects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root can image both an over-bound surge and an overwhelming punitive force. Later eradication under sovereign rule and equalization reverse the community's self-elevating overflow: the force that exceeded measure is brought to an undifferentiated level through the consequence attached to its guilt.

activation_trace.role: A rising, sweeping force supplies the geometry of the community's transgression.
An overwhelming punishment supplies a latent reversal within the same focus-root inventory.
Eradication supplies the terminal counterforce to the prior surge.
Sovereignty and mastery identify the governing power that contains the unbounded force.
Guilt supplies the causal attachment between communal action and its reversal.
Equalizing two things supplies the leveling endpoint opposed to self-elevating excess.

structural_cues: Verse 14 uses an action plus a bi-phrase linked to communal guilt, echoing the focus action plus bi-phrase linked to communal transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surge, overwhelming force, eradication, rule, guilt, and equalization; I infer a reversal in which the form of excess anticipates the form of its undoing. A live alternative is a straightforward crime-and-punishment sequence without shared force geometry.

changed_reading.before: The bi-phrase merely gives the moral cause of denial.
changed_reading.after: The community's overrun is a force-pattern that the context later reverses through eradication and leveling, so its excess already carries the shape of its undoing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear anticipates harm, and an aftermath is the tail left by an act. The closing negation lets the focus transgression be read as a broken feedback system: the collective verdict severs present desire from the future trace that should restrain it.

activation_trace.role: Crossing a proper limit supplies action that has ceased to regulate itself.
Declaring the warning false supplies the cognitive cut that disables restraint.
Alarm that anticipates coming harm supplies the missing forward-looking feedback.
The end and outcome of a thing supply the future state that denial refuses to admit.

structural_cues: The final clause negates fear and names an aftermath, but its compact grammar leaves the subject of the fear open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated fear and aftermath; I use them to model a feedback relation around the narrative without settling the subject of the closing verb. The live alternative is that the clause describes the executor's immunity rather than Thamud's psychology.

changed_reading.before: Denial concerns whether a present warning is true.
changed_reading.after: Denial also disables anticipation of the warning's tail, making transgression a system that refuses corrective feedback; this remains a framing contrast if the closing subject is not Thamud.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare non-dominant mapped branch in which the focus root concerns voice or noise. It remains anchored in word 3 and gains contextual support from utterance and raised voice; downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic social mechanism, not as the lexical translation of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 3 can activate a split-root branch of collective voice or noise, while word 1 still anchors the act of declaring the message false.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a speaker or report false supplies the hostile verdict carried by the sound.
A people's voice or noise supplies the unusual acoustic body of their excess.
Spoken utterance supplies the message that communal noise can overwhelm.
Raising the voice supplies a bridge from acoustic opposition to the violent action that follows.

changed_reading.before: Their transgression is a silent moral quality behind denial.
changed_reading.after: Their transgression can be heard as collective noise that performs denial by drowning the warning and swelling into action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates an idiom about milk failing to last. It remains focus-root anchored and becomes materially coherent beside the camel, watering share, and hamstringing; downstream prose should label it a provision-failure analogy, never a direct translation of the denial verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch in which an expected sustaining yield disappears or fails to continue.

activation_trace.role: Milk disappearing or failing to last as expected supplies the latent image of broken sustenance.
The camel supplies the concrete animal body that makes the yield image newly salient.
A watering share and channel supply the expected continuity of common provision.
Disabling the animal's legs supplies the act that makes the sustaining arrangement fail.

changed_reading.before: Thamud only labels a claim untrue.
changed_reading.after: Thamud makes a promised sustaining arrangement fail to endure, materially producing the falsity it asserts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a dyed-cloth image into an epistemic reading. It remains valid as an exact focus-root branch and is activated by contextual polishing, disclosure, and covering; downstream prose should retain it as a qualified surface analogy rather than equating denial with cloth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 can activate an object whose condition or patterned appearance itself deceives.

activation_trace.role: A patterned or dyed surface that deceives by its condition supplies denial as fabricated appearance.
Polishing and bringing clarity supply the exposure of what lies beneath the deceptive surface.
A cover laid over something supplies the obscuring layer from which the deceptive surface is made.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an inward judgment later expressed.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a manufactured public surface that lies by how it looks, covering what recurring disclosure would otherwise reveal.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from bare disbelief to a collective verdict whose excess is both cause and enforcing medium.
The paired inner breach and protection, followed by cultivation and burial, recast denial as active suppression of recognized truth.
The camel and watering-share sequence turns denial into enacted sabotage of an embodied sign and a bounded common resource.
Eradication, leveling, and aftermath reverse the community's overflow and expose the corrective feedback its verdict refused.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserved several coexisting mechanisms: juridical verdict, failed performance, hydrological overflow, structural breach, buried recognition, representative catalysis, resource sabotage, and reversal. Split-root and branch-distant activations also yielded contained acoustic, sustaining-yield, and deceptive-surface readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The bi-prefix can support causal and instrumental force, and the trace intentionally does not collapse them.
The physical overflow and water-governance model is strongly activated but need not exhaust the moral sense of transgression.
The grammatical subject of the closing fear clause remains open, so the feedback model may function as contrast rather than direct Thamud psychology.
The acoustic, failed-yield, and deceptive-surface outliers are material analogies anchored in packet branches, not replacement lexical glosses.
